name: excellent
description: Ready-made workflows for restaurant groups on Excellent: the morning brief across venues, lead follow-up and booking an inquiry, moving the pipeline, private-event space checks, event prep sheets and BEOs, thank-you cards, the marketing week, money owed and invoices, the owner's weekly report, the staff schedule, reviewing drafts and undoing a change. Drafts go to Excellent for a person to decide; changes can be undone.
